name: server_browser_actions
why: Enable the relay to run safe, sandboxed browser interactions without relying on the owner’s Mac being online, using Cloudflare Browser Run when available.

actions.description: High-level browser actions to perform (navigate, click, extract, search).

status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
